name_zh: 气候适应/荷兰/海平面/室内农业/循环经济/三角洲/全球输出
name_en: Climate Adaptation/Netherlands/Sea Level/Indoor Farming/Circular Economy/Delta/Global Export
description_zh: 荷兰作为三分之一国土低于海平面的国家，将气候生存危机转化为技术出口优势：三角洲工程防洪、温室园艺全球领先、循环经济模式输出、水外交成为外交新名片，室内垂直农业/海水淡化/海绵城市技术输出全球，低地生存智慧转化为气候技术霸权。
description_en: Netherlands with one-third land below sea level transforms climate survival crisis into tech export advantage: Delta Works flood defense, greenhouse horticulture global leadership, circular economy model export, water diplomacy as new diplomatic card, indoor vertical farming/seawater desalination/sponge city tech global export, lowland survival wisdom transforming into climate tech hegemony.
reason_zh: 荷兰气候适应代表生存危机如何转化为技术霸权与商业模式，展示了室内农业如何在资源匮乏环境实现高效粮食生产，其水外交与循环经济模式为全球沿海大都市气候适应提供了可复制的系统性方案。
reason_en: Dutch climate adaptation represents how survival crisis transforms into tech hegemony and business model, demonstrating how indoor farming achieves efficient food production in resource-scarce environments, its water diplomacy and circular economy model providing replicable systemic solution for global coastal megacities climate adaptation.
steps_zh: 研究荷兰地理/海平面/历史洪水/水管理传统
分析温室园艺/垂直农业/水肥一体化/全球出口第一
探讨循环经济/塑料回收/资源效率/欧盟绿色协议
评估水外交/三角洲工程输出/海绵城市/海平面上升应对
总结低地生存/室内农业/循环经济/气候技术输出/水外交五重遗产
steps_en: Study Dutch geography/sea level/historic floods/water management tradition
Analyze greenhouse horticulture/vertical farming/fertigation/global export first
Explore circular economy/plastic recycling/resource efficiency/EU Green Deal
Evaluate water diplomacy/Delta Works export/sponge cities/sea level rise response
Summarize lowland survival/indoor farming/circular economy/climate tech export/water diplomacy quintuple legacy
expected_zh: 掌握生存危机如何转化为技术霸权与商业模式，理解室内农业如何在资源匮乏实现高效粮食生产，评估荷兰水外交/循环经济模式对全球沿海大都市气候适应的系统性示范。
expected_en: Master how survival crisis transforms into tech hegemony and business model, grasp indoor farming achieving efficient food production in resource-scarce environments, evaluate Dutch water diplomacy/circular economy model systemic solution for global coastal megacities.
case_zh: 1953 大洪水；1997 三角洲工程；2015 巴黎协定/水外交；持续出口。低地生存/室内农业/循环经济/气候技术/水外交范式永存。
case_en: 1953 Great Flood; 1997 Delta Works; 2015 Paris Agreement/water diplomacy; ongoing export. Lowland survival/indoor farming/circular economy/climate tech/water diplomacy paradigm endures.
